title: twist-modal-translation
description: The translation nu sending each modal formula over the twist-product bilattice to a pair of classical-bimodal formulas, generated over the bilattice accessibility relation by splitting positive and negative evidence into two classical modal operators.

positiveComponent.description: nu_1: extracts the positive-evidence component of a formula as a classical-bimodal formula

negativeComponent.description: nu_2: extracts the negative-evidence component of a formula as a classical-bimodal formula

boxPositive.description: classical modal operator for the positive component of the accessibility relation R

boxNegative.description: classical modal operator for the negative component of the accessibility relation R

modalRecursion.description: nu_1(Box phi) := box_+ nu_1(phi) AND box_- ~nu_2(phi); nu_2(Box phi) := ~box_+ ~nu_2(phi); non-modal cases follow the standard twist-product translation
